4.20.betting_forecast: 5/2 Beau Quali, Quay Item, 3/1 Piping Rock, Treasure Planet, 16/1 Vanderflier, 33/1 Drumlee Orders, Yellow Warning, 50/1 Shuil
4.20.spotlight_verdict: The 4yo TREASURE PLANET may be capable of progress at this sort of distance and gets the percentage call in a tight-looking clash between the main form contenders. This first run since wind surgery is possibly the time to catch Piping Rock, who is second choice. Quay Item holds a good chance back down in trip, while Beau Quali is one to consider despite appearing more exposed.[Steve Boow]

4.55.betting_forecast: 13/8 Broomfields Cave, 7/2 Inflexible, Loup De Maulde, 6/1 Charles Ritz, 13/2 Manothepeople, 25/1 Amateur.
4.55.spotlight_verdict: The rise to a new career-high mark demands more of BROOMFIELDS CAVE but the form of his Wincanton dismissal of Loup De Maulde last time could easily have merited a greater hike than that meted out. Fellow last-time scorer Inflexible has a 4lb rise of his own to defy and is yet to strike above 0-115 company, but is preferred only marginally less. [Jeremy Grayson]

5.30.betting_forecast: 5/2 My Boy Aaron, 4/1 Mariole, Polemon, 5/1 Trapper John, 13/2 Both Of Us, 10/1 Jubertilee, Whatcombe, 25/1 Angel Wave,
5.30.spotlight_verdict: Three-time Flat winner BOTH OF US was behind two useful opponents when a 32l third over C&D three weeks ago and faces nothing of their ilk this time. He gets the nod ahead of My Boy Aaron, who has been running consistently well in defeat. Trapper John is third choice on the back of a near-miss on the AW.[Ben Hutton]

6.05.betting_forecast: 5/2 Aimeric, 3/1 Miss Kingston, 4/1 One Island, 5/1 Cheap Sandwiches, 10/1 Just Call Me Buzz, 12/1 Louis Des Landes, 16/1
6.05.spotlight_verdict: A race that revolves around Aimeric (second choice), who would dispatch this lot with the minimum of fuss if transferring his smart Flat form to this sphere. The betting may suggest whether that's expected or not so in the circumstances the suggestion is ONE ISLAND, who hasn't been finishing his races off but the tongue-tie might help in that regard and the pair who beat him last time are useful sorts. Miss Kingston also commands plenty of respect.[Richard Russell]

6.37.betting_forecast: Evs Torneo, 11/4 Hypotenus, 5/1 Bonza Boy, Parramount.
6.37.spotlight_verdict: Not the best race for the grade, with only the topweight rated under a stone within the ceiling, the three experienced chasers all above their last winning marks and Parramount not looking to the manner born belatedly switched to fences recently. TORNEO was at least compiling a string of career-best equalling RPRs before Class 2 company found him out here last time, and he's taken over Hypotenus, whom the stable switch and/or latest wind operation might help. [Jeremy Grayson]

7.07.betting_forecast: 15/8 The Kemble Brewery, 2/1 Wreckless Eric, 5/1 Razzle Dazzle Boy, 6/1 American Land, Inside Man.
7.07.spotlight_verdict: It's unwise to dismiss any of these, though Razzle Dazzle Boy may appreciate the projected drying forecast the least. Wreckless Eric hasn't especially enjoyed either visit to the Grand National meeting and may capitalise on an ease back in class, but a recent C&D second for THE KEMBLE BREWERY (nap) looked like that of one with plenty of remaining upside in handicaps, and the 2lb rise may not prove prohibitive. April 2025 C&D novice scorer Inside Man could yet revive. [Jeremy Grayson]

7.37.betting_forecast: 11/8 Stumps Or Slips, 11/4 Pink Eyed Pedro, 4/1 Yippee Ki Yay, 15/2 Important Notice, 14/1 Ideal Du Tabert, 16/1 Poppa Poutine,
7.37.spotlight_verdict: It seems almost sacrilegious to oppose Welsh doyen Pink Eyed Pedro ahead of this bid for a third Dunraven Bowl, but if anything looks set to spoil the party, it's STUMPS OR SLIPS. He was an easy Exeter winner recently over a rival who'd previously beaten Yippee Ki Yay just as comfortably at the same venue, and he's still fairly unexposed at tonight's trip. Connections won't mind the drying forecast at all. An upturn in Ideal Du Tabert's fortunes wouldn't defy logic. [Jeremy Grayson]

8.07.betting_forecast: 2/1 Star Walking, 11/4 Kilworth, 4/1 Hard Dealt, 6/1 I Spy A Diva, 9/1 Love Me, 12/1 Roaring Home, 16/1 Slim Marvel.
8.07.spotlight_verdict: The Star Walking who smashed the track record at Kempton over Christmas may take some containing if turning out again today, but the one who made a noise early at Kelso last time rather less so. No chances have been taken with the new mark allocated to the in-form Kilworth, so the competitively weighted I SPY A DIVA might emerge as a more viable threat, albeit with her present optimum trip not being crystal clear. [Jeremy Grayson]
